Research papers on multi-agent orchestration span comprehensive taxonomies, collaborative framework architectures, and dynamic coordination protocols.

### Surveys and Orchestration Taxonomies

- [Beyond Self-Talk: A Communication-Centric Survey of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14321v3)
  - **Authors:** Not listed in source snippet
  - **Year / Venue:** 2025 (updated 2026), arXiv preprint (`arXiv:2502.14321v3`)
  - **Focus:** Structures agent coordination into system-level communication (architectures, goals, protocols) and internal system communication (strategies, paradigms, objects, content) to analyze collective intelligence.
- [Meta-Thinking in LLMs via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: A Survey](http://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14520v1)
  - **Authors:** Ahsan Bilal, Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin, Muhammad Umer, Muhammad Awais Khan Bangash, Muhammad Ali Jamshed
  - **Year / Venue:** 2025, arXiv preprint (`arXiv:2504.14520v1`) / IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence submission
  - **Focus:** Evaluates multi-agent reinforcement learning orchestration models, organizing coordination mechanisms into supervisor-agent hierarchies, agent debates, and theory-of-mind frameworks.
- [Multi-Agent System Orchestration: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures and Applications](https://al-kindipublisher.com/index.php/jcsts/article/view/13147)
  - **Authors:** Rahul Kumar
  - **Year / Venue:** 2026, Journal of Computer Science and Technology Studies
  - **Focus:** Reviews architectural paradigms and negotiation strategies for orchestrating multi-agent systems across operational domains.

### Framework Architectures and Agent Collaboration

- [A survey on large language model based autonomous agents](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11704-024-40231-1)
  - **Authors:** Lei Wang, Chen Ma, Xueyang Feng, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Yang, Jingsen Zhang, Zhiyuan Chen, Jiakai Tang, Xu Chen, Yankai Lin, Wayne Xin Zhao, Zhewei Wei, Ji-Rong Wen
  - **Year / Venue:** 2024, Frontiers of Computer Science
  - **Focus:** Proposes a unified architectural model synthesizing agent construction, collaborative social coordination, multi-agent environment interaction, and framework abstractions including AutoGen, MetaGPT, and ChatDev.
- [The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.07864)
  - **Authors:** Zhiheng Xi, Wen-Xiang Chen, Xin Guo, Wei He, et al.
  - **Year / Venue:** 2023, arXiv preprint / Fudan NLP
  - **Focus:** Classifies agent society organization, role allocation, communicative topologies, and multi-agent collaborative schemes.
- [MultiAgentESC: A LLM-based Multi-Agent Collaboration Framework for Emotional Support Conversation](https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.232)
  - **Authors:** Yangyang Xu, Jinpeng Hu, Zhuoer Zhao, Zhangling Duan, et al.
  - **Year / Venue:** 2025, Proceedings of EMNLP 2025
  - **Focus:** Implements role-specialized sub-agent orchestration for communicative dialogic strategy execution.

### Dynamic Task Routing and Coordination Protocols

- [Multi-Agent Coordination Adaptation via Structure-Guided Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25746)
  - **Authors:** Haoran Li, Shulun Chen, Shaoyuan Sun, Hanchen Wang
  - **Year / Venue:** 2026, arXiv preprint (`arXiv:2605.25746`)
  - **Focus:** Introduces Structure-Guided Orchestration (SGO) to adapt coordination across distributed agents dynamically.

### Missing and Uncertain Information

- Citation metrics were largely unverified due to platform API limitations and Google Scholar anti-bot blocks.
- Authors for *Beyond Self-Talk* could not be extracted from the truncated API snippet.
- Granular standalone papers for specific orchestration frameworks (AutoGen, MetaGPT, ChatDev, CAMEL) and dedicated consensus/routing benchmarks were partially truncated or unretrieved due to query limits and selector parsing failures on arXiv search results.
